scripts.build: pnpm run fetch:codegen && astro check && astro build && pnpm run postbuild:hive && pnpm run postbuild:codegen && pnpm run postbuild:verify
scripts.postbuild:codegen: node scripts/codegen/generate-sitemap.ts && node scripts/codegen/generate-redirects.ts && pagefind --site dist/graphql/codegen
scripts.postbuild:hive: node scripts/hive/generate-sitemap.ts && node scripts/hive/generate-redirects.ts && node scripts/hive/generate-headers.ts && pagefind --site dist/graphql/hive
scripts.postbuild:verify: node scripts/hive/verify-base-path.ts && node scripts/verify-sitemaps.ts && node scripts/hive/check-seo.ts
